page_topic_one_liner: SERP anatomy — organic results, rich snippets, featured snippets, PAA, and SERP feature optimization
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional SEO SERP education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a recognizable Google-style results page layout with blue links, featured snippet box, and rich result elements — NOT an AI chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Google-style SERP mockup — search bar at top, 3-4 organic blue title links with grey URL lines and snippet blur, one featured snippet 'position zero' box highlighted with accent border
Rich snippet row: one result with 5 gold star rating + review count blur beneath a title link
Secondary: People Also Ask accordion stack (3 collapsed question rows with chevrons, blurred text)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is SEO SERP not GEO)
Generic magnifying glass alone without SERP layout
Affiliate dashboard or marketing UI unrelated to search results

en.headline: SERP GUIDE
en.subtitle: Results Pages & Rich Snippets
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for SERP SEO guide. HERO: realistic but generic search engine results page mockup occupying right two-thirds — top search input bar, stacked organic results with blue title links, grey URL/breadcrumb lines, blurred snippet paragraphs. One featured snippet answer box at top with accent klein-blue left border (position zero). Secondary: one organic result showing 5-star rich snippet rating row. Tertiary: People Also Ask accordion with 3 question rows. Title block top-left only. Paper collage torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO OpenAI/Anthropic logos, NO real Google logo, NO extra ranking numbers as text labels.
